title: Discovering Forbidden Topics in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Applying an Iterated Prefill Crawler (IPC) to elicit forbidden topics, calculating refusal rates on Chinese Communist Party (CCP) sensitive queries, and measuring logit differences to detect 'thought suppression' in reasoning models.

Using token prefilling and an automated crawling cycle (generation, deduplication, refusal detection) to discover and cluster topics that models systematically refuse to discuss, such as illegal activities, harmful language, and misinformation.
